_doc: Deliberate breakages for `prr mutate`: each one undoes a single behaviour; the selftest must fail when it is applied (to a copy — never to the live skill). `from` must occur exactly once in `file` (`prr mutate --check`, also enforced by the selftest). Add one whenever you fix a bug: it proves the new test bites.
